notes.title: Setting Lords of New York Free
notes.notes:
It's time for Vince to bounce from the big house. Lucky's free, Vince's free - the Lords of New York are running free!

On a serious note, what happened to Lords of New York? 

We worked hard on Lords of New York. Dozens of people sweated and pursued this ambitious title.. and by pursued, I mean, went after it 7 days a week for over 5 years. We made dozens of unique characters and stories, built our own cross platform, C++ engine from scratch, and even invented a new type of 2D animation and tooling. 

Why go free? Why did the work stop?

In the poker game of life... you make the best of your hand. Stopping development had nothing to do with the game, the team, tech, finances, community... it was life. Sometimes, it's simply time to release and allow for the next chapters of our lives and careers to take place.

Thank you for supporting us! While we left a lot on the table, and had even more in store, we're proud of this game. We gave it our all, and are proud of our efforts, the innovations, the awards, but most especially, grateful that you came on this journey with us.

You'll see us all again, spread throughout the industry with some big and creative things in the works!

Enjoy the game -- and at free, it's a great price. We hope you and your friends make this your new poker Thursday game.

Happy gaming!
Lunchtime Studios

notes.title: New Build - Notifications!
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1][list]
[*]New Notification System added to display information in real time. 
[*]Emotes bar is now hidden by default. Click the emotes button on the top left to toggle it on and off.
[/list]

[h1]Notifications[/h1][list]
[*]At the start of a match, we now remind the players of the objective of the venue. (Most money of 7 hands, winner take all, etc).
[*]Notify when you are hit with an ability. Green for buffs, red for being attacked.
[*]Notify when it's your turn
[*]Click on the notification to hide it
[*]Any key press will advance to the next notification (or hide them if none).
[/list]

[h1]AI[/h1][list]
[*]AI will use slightly fewer abilities. 
[/list]

notes.title: New Build - PAX South Enhancements
notes.notes:
[h1]General[/h1][list]
[*]The end game stage will now space out characters a bit more to reduce clipping.
[*]Emotes may now be used while waiting for upgrades to complete.
[/list]

[h1]Character Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved Carmen's Dogfight level 1 ability to show a card's value instead of the suit.
[*]Renamed Lucky's power [i]Second Look[/i] to [i]Double Take[/i]
[*]Fixed Lucky's Double Take ability to correctly use the +1 / +2 range (they were reversed)
[*]When using Lucky's Lucky card II ability on a card with the value of 2, it has a chance to become an Ace. Likewise, an Ace could become a 2.
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]Read Faces now has a tooltip
[*]Tooltips on status icons will show up with a red title for a debuff, and green for a buff.
[*]Lucky's Lucky card ability will highlight the affected cards when the next round occurs, and a new card hits the river.
[/list]

Enjoy! Much more on its way soon!

notes.title: New Build - Single Player Practice Mode Timers
notes.notes:
We've slowed down Single Player Practice Mode by removing the turn timer pressures. Now you'll have the time to explore and learn your favorite characters and their abilities before taking them into multiplayer battles!

[h1]Single Player Practice Mode[/h1][list][*]Turn timers are set to 7.5 minutes.
[*]Turn Timers will no longer auto-check / call / fold
[/list]
[h1]AI Thinking[/h1][list][*]The AI will slow down a bit and plan their moves more carefully. 

Game On!
